config.prediction_timing: before each recorded event, after documented pre-event replacements
config.missing_evidence_policy: inferred from recorded events, not confirmed medical or legal eligibility
config.untimed_absence_policy: audit only; never remove a player retrospectively from earlier features
config.replacement_quota_policy: shared outgoing-player slot for diagnostics; referee restrictions require review
config.formal_resource_policy: only whole matches marked ready_for_resource_features; same cohort for every experimental arm

limitations: Unrecorded injury and fielding absences are not observable.
Review flags may be retrospective; never use them as predictors.
No penalty-time or historical match-referee restriction simulator.
Nominal capacities are not jointly feasible allocations or next-bowler choices.
No resource-quality aggregation, training or accuracy claim.
